method: Second independent verifier, completeness/consistency lens. Read every entry note for internal contradictions; cross-checked against content/citations.json (all 62 FAR 1-19 keys present, none skipped), src/data/questions.json (278 questions; every rfo.crosswalk pair in Parts 1-19 compared to this file), src/data/regulations.json (110 crosswalk rows; the FAR 1-19 rows match except 15.207(c) still reads 15.108/probable and 15.201(c) still 'probable' - orchestrator should re-merge), content/out/crosswalk_far_22_53_dfars.json (no overlap; Parts 3/4/14/18/19 were covered by neither file) and content/out/thresholds.json (its DoD J&A and TINA figures contradicted this file - resolved from the DoD deviations). Re-downloaded RFO Parts 1, 2, 5, 7, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17 and newly Parts 3, 4, 14, 18, 19 with curl; fetched the three DoD RFO class deviations from acq.osd.mil (pdftotext). All 20 URLs in the file returned HTTP 200. Grepped the file for e-mail addresses and rank/name patterns: none. Checked JSON validity, UTF-8 without BOM, and that every entry has old/new/title/note/confidence/source_url and every 'new' value is RFO numbering. Sampled 40 questions for acronyms: src/data/glossary.json is an empty list, so every term is missing (outside this task; reported).

changes: FAR 7.107-2: note said 'section number and heading unchanged' - the heading changed from 'Consolidation' to 'Policy' and the section now absorbs old 7.107-3 and 7.107-4; rewritten with the 7.107-1(b) determination thresholds and the shifted 7.107-3/-4 numbering.

FAR 6.303 -> 6.104: note told Army users to quote the FAR Table 6-1 DoD column ($150M) and 'check DFARS 206.304'; contradicted content/out/thresholds.json (ja_dod_tier1-3). Confirmed from DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0017 Rev 2 that DoD uses DFARS 206.104-71 Table 206-1 ($10M / $100M / $500M) in lieu of Table 6-1; corrected and source_url_dod added.

FAR 16.505(b)(2) -> 16.507-6(b): the (e) approval tiers were stated as if they applied to DoD; DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0045 Rev 1 substitutes the DFARS 206.104 (Table 206-1) authorities. Added, with source_url_dod.

FAR 15.403-4 -> 15.403-3: note gave only the $2.5M FAR figure; contradicted thresholds.json (tina_dod $10M). Confirmed DFARS 215.403-3(a) under Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Rev 1 ($10M for DoD prime contracts awarded after 30 Jun 2026); added with source_url_dod.

FAR 2.101: note said 'with contingency/OCONUS exceptions' without the figures a board asks for; added the fetched contingency MPT/SAT values and flagged the stale '13.201(g)(1)' cross-reference inside the RFO definition (RFO 13.201 has no (g)).
FAR 15.503 -> 15.206-1: entry covered only old 15.503(a) preaward notices; old 15.503(b) postaward notices map to 15.207-2 Award notice (as the question bank already records). Note completed.
FAR 12.201-1: added the $15 million contingency ceiling at 12.001(c) (the Army 'SaP' Class II warrant figure).

Added 31 entries for Parts 1-19 cites that the question bank's rfo.crosswalk pairs or the Army Warranting Policy use but citations.json does not list (so neither crosswalk task covered them): 1.102-4(e), 1.602-1, 1.603, 1.403-1(b), 3.104, 4.801-4.803, 7.107-3/-4/-5/-6, 12.603, 12.301, 13.5, 13.302-5, 14.404-2(g), 15.204-1, 15.304, 15.305, 15.306, 15.506, 17.502-1(b), 18.2, 19.102, 19.4, 19.502-2, 19.805-1, 19.13, 19.14, 19.15, 19.8, 19.7. Each verified against the RFO part page fetched 13 Sep 2026. Parts 3, 4, 14, 18 and 19 were previously absent from the map entirely.
